affected_subject.reason: Identifies Float128::toPackedFloat and its isResultL normalization logic.

trigger_or_action.reason: Inputs with digits > 38 but exponent much less than MAXIMUM_EXPONENT cause isResultL to be false.

direct_effect.reason: Numbers wrongly stored in M_MANTISSA range instead of L_MANTISSA, causing significant precision loss.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected L_MANTISSA storage for valid 38<digits<72 inputs vs actual M_MANTISSA storage gives expected-vs-actual relation.

summary: Report identifies the affected function, triggering input conditions, concrete precision-loss effect, and expected-vs-actual normalization mismatch.
